3	Patch2Self is a self-supervised denoising method for diffusion MRI. In the
4	standard formulation, each diffusion-weighted volume is predicted from the
5	remaining acquisitions, so the output keeps the same shape and acquisition
6	order as the input. The method is designed to work without an explicit clean
7	target.
8	
9	The bundled snapshot uses a compact 4D diffusion-style array so the workflow
10	can be inspected offline. The source code still follows the same public API
11	ideas as the full library: baseline images have different semantics from
12	diffusion-weighted volumes, and some variants include spatial-locality controls
13	or intensity post-processing. The task snapshot keeps those ideas intact while
14	using a much smaller synthetic case.

17	than a separate normalization step. Clipping negative values and shifting
18	intensities are distinct options: clipping floors values at zero, while an
